daily_prompts_month_day_calendar_check.name: daily_prompts_month_day_calendar_check
daily_prompts_month_day_calendar_check.value:
case
        when "daily_prompts"."month_day" !~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$' then false
        when substring("daily_prompts"."month_day", 1, 2) in ('01', '03', '05', '07', '08', '10', '12') then substring("daily_prompts"."month_day", 4, 2)::integer <= 31
        when substring("daily_prompts"."month_day", 1, 2) in ('04', '06', '09', '11') then substring("daily_prompts"."month_day", 4, 2)::integer <= 30
        else substring("daily_prompts"."month_day", 4, 2)::integer <= 29
      end

friend_requests_resolution_check.name: friend_requests_resolution_check
friend_requests_resolution_check.value: ("friend_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "friend_requests"."resolved_at" is null) or ("friend_requests"."status" <> 'pending' and "friend_requests"."resolved_at" is not null)
